title: Toyota Boshoku Corporation
headings: Joy from the “QUALITY OF TIME AND SPACE” We introduce the Toyota Boshoku group’s initiatives of R&D.

We introduce our activities which contribute to the realization of a sustainable global environment through「Global warming prevention」「Resource circulation」「Co-existence with nature」, the three priority actions of the Toyota Boshoku group 2050 Environmental Vision.
Through this media site, we will inform you about how we, the Toyota Boshoku group, are thinking about the future and what we are currently working on.
